families.semantic_fact: Notify publication is the exact finite before/after truth relation and is never scheduling authority.
families.falsifier: Suppressing a true edge can strand its waiter; publishing a false edge adds bounded but observable notify, probe and guard work.
families.parallelism: Resolve, verify, Ready, dependency, effect and template waiters retain independent levels and releasers.
families.added_cost: The reference relation and production differential add zero runtime state; one stack-owned before/after observation is already carried post-commit.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the relation, both lost progress and unbounded spurious prompt cost can pass as equivalent signal behavior.

families.semantic_fact: One coherent effect-log cut has exactly one Receipt, Idle or ClosedAndDrained observation and one named next releaser.
families.falsifier: Collapsing Idle with terminal drain either terminates before committed effects settle or waits forever after close.
families.parallelism: The sole publisher performs endpoint I/O outside the authority guard while effect producers remain independently concurrent.
families.added_cost: The model and production observation add zero runtime state, retry or watchdog; receipt cloning occurs only when the publisher acquires an available head, never in Apply wake projection.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the three-way observation, None cannot distinguish temporary absence from an absorbing closed-and-drained cut.

families.semantic_fact: At a stable dependency epoch every maintenance Apply consumes a sealed nonempty successor and strictly decreases a finite edge-plus-completion-marker rank; a fixed projection decreases by exactly one, while an owner requeue may atomically retire additional waiter obligations from current and pending epochs.
families.falsifier: A defaultable or prepared no-progress successor leaves the stable rank unchanged, while an incomplete rank can reject a legal requeue that removes multiple obligations in one atomic Apply.
families.parallelism: External events may publish a strictly newer pending epoch; they do not serialize unrelated keys or worker computation.
families.added_cost: The global rank is proof-only; production may carry one sealed local successor witness and no full-frontier scan.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the stable-epoch rank, arbitrary loop limits and unbounded drains are the only remaining termination arguments.

families.semantic_fact: A discardable Plan may reserve prospective version/arrival identities without requiring a sequence; each nonempty authority Apply then consumes that sole Plan into one sequence, the exact identity ranges and exactly the dependency/effect controls its owner changes require.
families.falsifier: Reserving sequence before nonemptiness rejects a legal pressure no-op at the counter boundary, while a defaultable clock or projection field can publish an owner transition without advancing its identity or derived authority cut.
families.parallelism: Plan remains lock-local and effect I/O remains post-commit; one sealed commit does not move compute under the authority guard.
families.added_cost: Sealed stack-owned capabilities replace optional/default construction and add no owner, task, queue or retry state.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the sealed commit, structural field deletion silently creates representable partial transitions.

families.semantic_fact: Positive, missing and owner-free dependency evidence are current exactly when no relevant key or unindexed loss/change follows the sealed cut.
families.falsifier: Weakening any cut comparison can retain proof across a definitive loss or miss a newly discovered unindexed dependency.
families.parallelism: Evidence producers read immutable snapshots outside Apply; only level publication and owner changes are atomically ordered.
families.added_cost: The reference frontier is proof-only and production retains its existing sparse indexed levels.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without one currentness relation, each caller can invent a different loss boundary and create split proof authority.

families.semantic_fact: Admission and rejection observations bind the exact chain view, raw/full identity, ready owner version, proof view and dependency/source cut.
families.falsifier: Dropping one equality accepts a nearby transaction, view, owner phase or source generation as the committed subject.
families.parallelism: Validation stays outside the authority mutation cut and returns one immutable receipt for Plan revalidation.
families.added_cost: The model adds zero runtime fields; refinement may only seal facts already present in the receipt and owner.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without a single receipt relation, green validators cannot prove that every production caller checks the same subject.

families.semantic_fact: Input availability and history triggers are derived only from the projected final spender/parent set and exact chain-backed provenance.
families.falsifier: Publishing an input at output_count equality or while a spender/parent survives can wake a false recovery and corrupt conflict ownership.
families.parallelism: The finite membership cohort is canonically planned once; unrelated transactions and validation remain parallel.
families.added_cost: The relation reuses the bounded membership cohort and adds no index, scan, cache or second owner.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the final-set relation, administrative removal, RBF and history retention can publish contradictory availability.

families.semantic_fact: All six resource dimensions, compute reservation and peer attribution are constructed and changed as one exact set transition.
families.falsifier: A partial reservation, invalid limit hierarchy, wrong peer release or caller-order-dependent batch leaks or double-charges hostile work.
families.parallelism: Sparse per-owner accounting stays transition-local and does not serialize compute or introduce a global recount.
families.added_cost: The reference ledger is test-only; sealed production constructors may remove checks but cannot add runtime owners or scans.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the continuous equation, phase-local counters can each appear valid while aggregate residency escapes its bound.

families.semantic_fact: Scheduler membership is an order-independent set transition; committed plus Plan overlay eligibility forms one bounded Trusted-first owner ring.
families.falsifier: Intersection eligibility, lost verify order/cursor or absent next-after traversal can starve an eligible owner or change deterministic order.
families.parallelism: Only cursor selection is canonically committed; resolve and verify execution remain outside the authority guard and parallel by worker role.
families.added_cost: The model adds zero runtime structure; the existing committed and overlay populations bound every probe.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the ring quotient, overlay work can become a second scheduler authority or be invisible to a complete wave.

families.semantic_fact: One move-only completion is totally classified from its sealed view, identity, dependency cut, payload policy and rejection validity domain.
families.falsifier: Weakening an identity/policy conjunction retains stale proof, blames the wrong source or terminalizes work that must re-resolve.
families.parallelism: Workers compute independently; only the returned capability's owner/resource/effect disposition is ordered in Apply.
families.added_cost: The model is pure; production already carries every premise in the completion capability and owner cut.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the total table, each settlement variant can silently use a different currentness or source-policy boundary.

families.semantic_fact: Fallible reservation, the effect-bounded administrative prefix, exact operational metrics and sealed expiry-index producer premises remain contractual observations rather than policy authority.
families.falsifier: Erasing reservation, prefix truncation or one metrics field changes a legal observation; removing the exact owner/index/cutoff producer premise makes the defensive expiry perturbations observably different.
families.parallelism: Allocation remains in Plan, retirement outside the guard and metrics read-only; no observation serializes mutation paths.
families.added_cost: Finite model and test-only adapters add no runtime state or hot-path operation; production retains its existing reserve, prefix, counter read and defensive validation work.
families.deletion_counterexample: Without the contract family, legal capacity, bound and metrics differences or a broken expiry producer can disappear behind non-semantic mutation labels.

proofs.semantic_fact: The legal authority invariant derives the Remote deadline index from the owner, the only RemoteExpiry producer selects an indexed deadline at or before the cutoff, and the planner redundantly rejects any owner/index mismatch before invoking the common removal compiler.
proofs.falsifier: A legal producer cut with owner deadline after the cutoff makes the forced-true guard observably accept a non-due owner.

proofs.semantic_fact: The legal authority invariant derives the Accepted deadline index from the immutable owner value, the only Accepted-expiry producer returns a row at or before the cutoff, and the planner redundantly revalidates both facts before compiling removal.
proofs.falsifier: A legal producer cut with exactly one of stale-index or future-owner true distinguishes the disjunction from its conjunctive perturbation.

cost.transient_bound: O(B) prepared owner changes for configured batch bound B
cost.apply_bound: one Apply sequence and one atomic projection commit per batch

cost.transient_bound: P assignment slots plus P completion slots for retained compute capacity P

cost.transient_bound: existing Ready prefix bound and effect partition capacity

points.capability_disposition: Validation reads one coherent authority cut and yields sealed evidence without mutation authority; cancellation before planning leaves ownership, charge and effects unchanged.
Dropping a fully prepared bounded membership plan is semantically mutation-free; no owner, charge, scheduler fact, clock or effect has moved.
Apply commits the terminal owner outcome and immutable effect together; dropping an unprocessed publication receipt retains the exact charged FIFO head.
Cancellation or a closed assignment transport returns or settles the exact checked-out capability once and restores queued work without leaking active-work charge.
Cancellation during external I/O leaves tentative progress at the authoritative FIFO head so the sole replacement publisher resumes without loss or duplicate settlement.
Maintenance owns no transaction outside each bounded Apply; cancellation exits cleanly, while every preexisting expiry and dependency level drains fairly before quiescence.
Shutdown publishes the absorbing verification stop, joins authority workers, closes and drains committed effects, and only then exposes persistence eligibility.

residual_risks.R2: External effects are not crash durable or universally exactly-once.
residual_risks.R3: Persistence is best effort and every replayed transaction re-enters validation.
residual_risks.R4: Process OOM abort, FFI failure and memory corruption are outside the tx-pool model.
residual_risks.R5: Derived template failure can retain the last valid template and underfill until a source change.
residual_risks.R6: Optional replacement history can be discarded as a complete set under its bounded sub-budget.
residual_risks.R7: Legacy v1 persistence remains an accepted compatibility input.
residual_risks.R8: Peer-ban fence saturation evicts the oldest fence; a delayed submission from that session must re-enter full bounded validation.
